description: This file defines a static class DdlEncoder providing methods for encoding and decoding DDL text, including string escaping, literal conversion, identifier validation, and quoting.

classes.name: DdlEncoder
classes.description: Provides static methods for encoding and decoding DDL text, including string escaping, literal conversion, identifier validation, and quoting.

methods.name: StringToText
methods.description: Converts a string into a text phrase with escape sequences for special characters.

methods.name: StringToLiteral
methods.description: Converts a string into a quoted string literal with escape sequences.

methods.name: IsDdeIdentifier
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid DDE identifier, limited to 64 characters and starting with a letter or underscore.

methods.name: QuoteIfNameContainsBlanks
methods.description: Quotes the name if it contains invalid identifier characters; otherwise returns the name unchanged.
